author: Tobias Gröger
name: nind_denoise_rl
description: nind_denoise_rl.lua integrates NIND neural-network denoising (with Richardson-Lucy deconvolution) as a darktable plugin: it exports, runs the Python NN backend, and re-imports the denoised image carrying the full history stack. Shared on pixls.us thread 56567.
description-extensive: Adds a powerful AI-based noise-removal step to darktable for cleaning up grainy, noisy photos (for example, high-ISO shots taken in low light). It appears as a new export option: pick your noisy images, export through the "NIND-denoise" target, and it runs them through a trained denoising model, then automatically imports the cleaned result back into darktable and stacks it with the original. You can either get a finished denoised file or bring the denoised image back for further editing. It needs a Python environment with PyTorch installed (and works faster with a supported GPU: NVIDIA, AMD, or Intel), and it downloads its denoising model automatically on first use.
